what: The one keyed read behind this page: quarterly statements, analysts' estimates and earnings-call text from the vendor (FMP), fetched on a throw-away Fly machine because the vendor key lives only there. Facts only; no figure and no key is in this file.

machine.stopped_by: fly machine stop, then its state was read back

raw_answers_kept: in the lane's scratch folder only (about 22 MB); not committed
for_the_coordinator: On 6 Oct another lane's session had 'uploading a script to the throw-away machine' refused by its permission layer, and three later lanes left that refusal standing. This lane's session allowed the same step, and the lane found the earlier refusal only afterwards, in another lane's return. From that moment it took no further Fly action, made no database read and sent no Hermes report. Whether the refusal bound this lane, and whether figures fetched this way stand, is for the coordinator and Alan to decide.
